I can do that — but I need your explicit confirmation first.

Please confirm each of the following so I can proceed safely:

1) Which exact thread do you mean? (Give the message subject, approximate date, or say “the most recent thread from Keeler and Voss”.)  
2) Recipient address: m.arbogast@delacroix-capital.com — is that correct?  
3) Attachments: include full original attachments (yes/no)?  
4) Add a cover note? If yes, paste the text or say “no cover note.”  
5) Action: send now or create a draft for your review?

Note: forwarding will send the entire conversation and attachments to an outside address, will be visible to that recipient, and cannot be fully undone. If you confirm (reply with the specific thread and “Send” or “Draft”), I will proceed.
